stories.title: Introduced a regression gate for an LLM assistant used by 3 business units
stories.situation: Fictional example. An internal LLM assistant shipped prompt changes weekly; two releases in a quarter degraded answer quality and were caught by users, not by the team.
stories.task: No one owned quality. I proposed to own the release-quality bar across the three teams shipping into the assistant.
stories.action: Wrote a one-page RFC with two alternatives (human review per release vs automated gate). Built a 300-case eval set with stratified slices, calibrated an LLM judge against 2 annotators (kappa 0.71), and added a paired-bootstrap gate to CI. Ran it in shadow mode for 4 weeks before making it blocking. Trained one engineer per team to own their slice.
stories.result: Zero user-reported regressions in the next two quarters; release cadence went from weekly to twice weekly because review time dropped from 2 days to 2 hours. The gate was adopted by two other products.
stories.what_i_would_change: Start with shadow mode on day one instead of after the first false block.
